newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: J.Martins seeks business in Iberia, Latam.
newsitem.headline: J.Martins seeks business in Iberia, Latam.

text.p: Portugal's second biggest retailer Estabelecimentos Jeronimo Martins e Filho is seeking to expand its business activities in Iberia, South America and Central Europe, its Finance Director Jorge Ponce de Leao said.
"We are continuing to study business opportunities in Iberia, South America and Central Europe," Ponce de Leao said on Monday on the sidelines of a presentation about the company.
Jeronimo Martins was closely studying trends in the retail sector in Spain and was determined not to be left behind, he said.
"If our competitors develop joint strategies, for example in terms of stocks, we will have to follow suit," he added.
"We would like to take part in a big market like Brazil, but we must be aware that Brazil is still a risk," Ponce de Leao said.
He added large, well-established retail groups already operated in Brazil, which was a disincentive to foreign groups interested in entering South America's biggest market.
"We have to find solutions that would enable us to enter the Brazilian market, in order to face up to the competition, without compromising the financial structure of the group," Ponce de Leao said.
He added that Jeronimo Martins was interested in developing its presence in Central Europe, including Poland where it already operates a chain of cash-and-carry shops, and Slovakia.
